warnings: The supplied questionnaire text and SAV dictionary conflict on Q120/Q125: the document explicitly displays four products (NSAIDs, Colchicine, Corticosteroids, Arcalyst), while the SAV dictionary contains five variables including q120_4/q125_4 for Kineret. The dictionary variables are retained and should be reviewed against programming.

The document defines Q130 as 14 attributes with multiple product columns, but the compact manifest represents the first attribute explicitly and records the remaining exact dictionary family as requiring individual child mapping. Do not omit q130_2_1 through q130_14_99.

The dataset dictionary contains qtestvideo, but the supplied document does not contain QTestVideo. It is excluded as dictionary-only because it cannot be assigned questionnaire routing or requiredness from the dictionary alone.

The dataset dictionary contains many candidate system, instruction, error, product-profile, timestamp, and quality fields. These are excluded individually as application/system metadata rather than respondent questionnaire items.
Shared ordinary-question requiredness applies unless an explicit routing/exception is documented. Administrative blocks are supplied by the application and are not duplicated.
Include the shared test-token check for all open-ended fields and the supplied administrative defaults in the application-level validation layer.
